title: Building the Metaverse
description: Join our panel of experts in the exciting realm of building the metaverse! Our panelists, comprising of technologists, futurists, and visionaries, will delve into the latest trends, challenges, and opportunities in the rapidly evolving landscape of the metaverse. From XR experiences, to blockchain, Web3, and social interactions in the virtual world, our panelists will share their insights, strategies, and visions for the future of the metaverse.
